designs.title: Solid aluminium cylinder turning in the travelling field of a slotless three-phase belt winding
designs.purpose: A belt winding in free space around a solid conducting cylinder, at standstill and at two speeds. FEMM has no velocity term; each spatial order is solved at its own slip frequency (conjugated when negative) and the orders superposed (harmonic_superposition). The cylinder reflects each order by a closed-form Bessel factor, which gives the torque and, through the slip power, the rotor loss.

designs.title: 6/4 switched reluctance machine: phase placement and coil polarity from symmetry
designs.purpose: Tapered stator poles with coil blocks and flat-rooted rotor poles (salient_poles), three phases of opposite pole pairs (salient_pole_winding), nonlinear M-19. Turning the whole machine by 60 degrees maps phase A onto phase B and the rotor onto itself turned by -30 degrees, so B's flux linkage at rotor angle theta - 30 equals A's at theta, saturated or not. Opposite polarity of a phase's two coils sends the flux straight through the rotor, so with A aligned the gap field's x component is the same at both A poles; equal polarity would reverse it at one. 12 rotor positions over a rotor pole pitch, each for A and for B.

designs.title: Outer-rotor 24-slot Vernier PM machine with tapered shoes and a radially layered winding
designs.purpose: Checks the stator and winding options the Tlali 2020 Vernier generator needed, at new dimensions: parallel teeth with tapered shoes (slotted_stator shoe_corner_axial_distance), slots closed at the shoe roots so the space between the shoes joins the gap, a radial layer divider and a distributed double layer pitched 5 of 6 slots (tooth_coil_winding coil_pitch, return_layer_radius), under an outer rotor of 44 magnets (Ns = pr + ps). The sliding band's inner angle turns the stator, so the rotor's angle is its negative (rotor_band_side outer). The construction predicts each phase's flux-linkage phase at the rotor's 22nd harmonic and the order A, C, B (the modulated field turns against the rotor); 16 positions over half an electrical period, with half-wave symmetry, check it natively.

designs.title: Periodic slotted linear primary with a double-layer winding over an aluminium sheet
designs.purpose: A linear induction machine's primary over one 192 mm period (linear_slotted_core with half teeth at the periodic ends, semi-closed slots, two layers; linear_winding's coils pitched 5 of 6 slots and wrapped round the period) above an aluminium sheet on laminated iron, at standstill and 50 Hz. A third of a period carries phase A's coils onto B's, so the phase flux linkages are balanced and 120 degrees apart in the order the construction gives, and the field travels in the direction the slot phases predict, dragging the sheet: forward toward +x, reversed toward -x.

designs.title: Four-pole wound-field salient-pole machine with eccentric pole faces and layered trapezoidal slots
designs.purpose: Checks the components the Bazzo 2021 salient-pole generator needed, at new dimensions: salient_pole_rotor with eccentric pole faces (a 50 mm face radius on a 59 mm rotor), straight shoe tips, a square core whose flat sides carry field coils that stop short of its corners, three damper bars per pole and a steel shaft, with the interpolar spaces closed and meshed apart from the gap; trapezoidal_slot_stator's closed wedges and radial layer divider under a distributed double layer pitched 5 of 6 slots. The rotor's source is the field winding's current distribution (linkage_prediction for wound-field rotors): the construction predicts each phase's flux-linkage phase and the order A, B, C as the rotor turns counterclockwise; 16 positions over half an electrical period, with half-wave symmetry, check it natively.
